capabilities: Change task status markers on selected lines via a searchable modal
Transform non-task lines, blank lines, and cursor placements into tasks
Search status markers with a fuzzy finder
Configure custom status markers in the plugin settings
disambiguation: Not a task-management or tracking plugin; it only rewrites the status marker characters on selected lines.
extras: Styling of custom markers is not included: the README requires a theme (Things, Minimal, AnuPpuccin, ITS) or a custom CSS snippet, and includes setup instructions for those themes. Known limitations include incorrect handling of code blocks, Obsidian comments, and Setext headings within selections.
intentEvidence: the goal is to complement other task related plugins
motivation: The author wanted a keyboard-driven, searchable way to jump between any checkbox status without memorizing marker characters.
problem: Changing a checkbox to a status other than done requires remembering which character maps to which marker or editing the text manually, and the built-in toggle only cycles one status.
summary: Command-driven modal that applies or swaps task status markers on selected lines, with fuzzy search and configurable status markers.
